answer: A sybil farm defeats cheap gates by buying compute or delegating to one model. So price identity by scarce judgment: every agent must submit an original, jury-scored mechanism each epoch, and a shared-generation fingerprint over submission diffs links clones before they scale. Picture one intent refracted through a prism into many violet identities — each looks distinct yet shares one spectrum. The timber of that shared signal is what exposes them, making mass identity cost far more than a mere join fee.
